summary: Frontend-only UI validation of Phase 1 Wealth Coach features (empty states, manual accounts, per-currency, Settings sections, change password, prefs persistence, notification toggle, export, delete-dialog cancel, alex regression, Plaid button, onboarding 3-choice). 24/25 scenarios pass end-to-end. ONE CRITICAL BUG: Onboarding.jsx country-select buttons call `setBanks([])` but `setBanks` is not defined in the component — clicking any country throws a React runtime error (Emergent runtime overlay: 'setBanks is not defined' at bundle.js:16024:11), freezing the onboarding flow for every brand-new signup. This blocks the entire real-signup -> start-sample / start-manual / start-connect path. Everything else (verify banner + resend toast, home empty state + CTA, money empty state + add-account, manual CAD account with CA$ + Manual badge, Settings 7 sections, edit profile name persistence, change-password wrong/mismatch/valid, prefs CAD + DD/MM persist after reload, budget_alerts toggle persist, JSON export download, delete dialog opens + Cancel closes, alex demo regression dashboard loaded, Plaid button renders on Money) works.

ui_bugs.issue: onClick calls `setBanks([])` but `setBanks` state setter is never declared (component only has name/country/goal/help/loading state). Clicking ANY country button raises 'ReferenceError: setBanks is not defined' and the Emergent runtime-error overlay takes over the screen. This blocks every new signup from completing onboarding, so the start-connect-btn / start-manual-btn / start-sample-btn step is unreachable in the real UI path. Reproduce: register new user -> /onboarding -> type name -> Continue -> click [data-testid=country-canada] -> runtime error.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.jsx line 95, remove the stray `setBanks([])` call inside the country button onClick — it's leftover from a previous step and `banks` state no longer exists. Change `onClick={() => { setCountry(co.c); setBanks([]); }}` to `onClick={() => setCountry(co.c)}`. After fix, re-run the onboarding E2E to confirm start-sample-btn lands on dashboard with sample data and start-manual/start-connect land on /app/money empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx: dead reference to removed `setBanks` state — this must have been caught in review. Suggest wiring up a lint rule or at least a quick smoke test of the onboarding flow in CI.

Money.jsx: UI correctly suppresses the top-right Add-account button when `isEmpty` (showing the empty-state version instead) — good UX but means two separate <AddAccountDialog /> trees exist in the DOM depending on state; fine today, worth a note.
Settings.jsx: both the profile edit dialog and change-password dialog correctly await `refreshUser()` before closing — persistence works. Export uses blob + revokeObjectURL properly.

VerifyBanner.jsx: once a user hits Resend, the button is disabled permanently (`disabled={sending || sent}`). If the email fails to arrive the user has no retry inside the same session; consider a short cooldown instead of a hard lock.
Onboarding.jsx goal step: `setGoal` has no deselect — clicking the same goal doesn't toggle off. Minor.
Money AddAccountDialog defaults currency to USD even though the signed-in user may have country=Canada / display_currency=CAD. Consider defaulting form.currency to user.preferences.display_currency.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (24/25 scenarios). The one failure (onboarding country click) is critical and blocks real new-user signup end-to-end.

rca of the issue: Onboarding.jsx previously had a `banks` state (likely for a 'select which bank' step). That state was removed, but one leftover reference `setBanks([])` was left inside the country-button onClick (`onClick={() => { setCountry(co.c); setBanks([]); }}` at line 95). React doesn't catch undefined identifiers at render time; the ReferenceError only fires on click, which is why the previous iteration's auth-only tests didn't trip it. Mitigation: delete the `setBanks([])` call. One-liner fix.
